one_liner: ClickUp offers a REST API with OAuth2 and personal tokens for productivity automation.
gating_notes: Personal API tokens are self-serve for individual use. OAuth apps require creating an app in the developer portal. API endpoints and rate limits vary by Workspace Plan.
oauth_details: OAuth2 flow is supported for building apps for others, allowing users to authorize Workspaces. Personal API tokens are used for personal use.

auth_methods.quote: For personal use, authenticate with your personal API token. For apps or integrations that other people use, use the OAuth flow

primary_auth.quote: For apps or integrations that other people use, use the OAuth flow, allowing users to authorize Workspaces for your app.

credential_access.quote: For personal use, authenticate with your personal API token.

api_breadth.quote: In the API reference section you will find a few individual endpoints that are defined as API v3. We're working on updating the rest of the API to v3

existing_mcp.quote: Use ClickUp right from your AI assistant.](https://developer.clickup.com/docs/connect-an-ai-assistant-to-clickups-mcp-server)
